tasks.title: Lock the click-only two-page feedback contract
tasks.objective: Update the canonical feedback interaction contract and verify that the simplified payload fits existing private persistence without a migration.
authority: The dialog may open only from an explicit visitor action on the Feedback control.
The form has exactly two pages: general feedback, then the existing founder/social/contact content.
Prefer existing optional storage fields and preserve historical feedback rows.
No external provider or human dashboard task is authorized during this issue unless a verified schema blocker is separately approved.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical contract removes automatic opening and six-step survey behavior.
The payload-to-existing-schema mapping and partial/completed save behavior are explicit.
No destructive data or migration requirement is introduced.
verification: Trace the simplified payload through service validation and both repository implementations.
Confirm existing stored feedback remains readable and untouched.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop when the two-page behavior and migration-free compatibility are proven or an exact schema blocker is documented.
tasks.evidence: Locked the click-only, exactly-two-page contract in the canonical product specification. Verified the general response maps to the existing optional whyOrWhyNot field, removed survey fields remain nullable, local and Supabase mappings remain compatible, and existing rows require no rewrite or migration.

tasks.title: Implement intentional two-page feedback
tasks.objective: Replace the auto-opening branched survey with the approved click-only two-page dialog while preserving private saves and contact options.
write_scope: feedback widget markup and client behavior
only required backward-compatible service validation changes
focused UI, route, persistence, accessibility, and regression tests
authority: Delete route, timer, form-action, and session-triggered automatic opening behavior.
Keep founder social destinations and optional contact fields from the current last page.
Preserve Origin, body-size, rate-limit, validation, privacy, autosave/close behavior where it still makes sense, and mobile full-screen presentation.
Do not expose saved feedback publicly.
acceptance_criteria: The dialog remains closed until Feedback is clicked on every rendered route.
Only general feedback and founder/contact pages are presented.
General feedback can be submitted without contact information, and contact fields remain optional.
Private persistence and desktop/mobile accessibility tests pass.
verification: Run focused feedback service, route, repository, and widget tests.
Run desktop and mobile browser smoke confirming no automatic opening and a successful two-page submission.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop when feedback is voluntary, exactly two pages, privately saved, accessible, and verified without destructive schema work.
tasks.evidence: Replaced the auto-opening branched survey with a click-only general-feedback and founder/contact flow. Next completes the feedback before the optional contact page; later contact saves update the same completed response. Retained draft autosave and close-to-save behavior, added explicit recovery copy, and preserved private route/security controls. Six focused tests, desktop submission at 1280x720, and mobile full-screen layout at 390x844 passed.
